name: Replace mysql_connect with mysqli_connect
description: The mysql extension is deprecated in PHP 5.5 and removed in PHP 7.0. Use mysqli or PDO instead.

name: Replace each() with foreach loop wrapper
description: The each() function is deprecated in PHP 7.2 and removed in PHP 8.0.

name: Replace split() with explode() or preg_split()
description: The split() function is deprecated in PHP 5.3 and removed in PHP 7.0. Use explode() for simple splitting or preg_split() for regex.
